subject: POC hands-on session — slot triage, prompt review & preflight pack
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Aria Lopez <aria.lopez@finovate.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on slots + preflight pack

Hi Aria,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Were excited to get the hands-on POC started and want to lock the kickoff session that'll include: prompt review, routing checks, and a short load test (non-production traffic).

Proposed 90-minute slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-02-24 10:00-11:30
- Wed 2026-02-25 13:00-14:30
- Thu 2026-02-26 08:30-10:00

Attached is a short preflight pack (POC-Preflight-Checklist.pdf) and a draft agenda (Agenda-v1.pptx). The pack lists required accounts/roles, data routing preferences, and a suggested prompt seed set (Prompt-Seed-Set.csv).

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will be on the session (ops + engineering ideally)? If none of the above work, send two windows that do and well accommodate.

Also looping Laura and Ben from our CS and Solutions team to cover the load-run and routing items.

Thanks,
Diego

Attachments: POC-Preflight-Checklist.pdf (42KB), Agenda-v1.pptx (1.2MB), Prompt-Seed-Set.csv (12KB)

From: Aria Lopez <aria.lopez@finovate.co>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: finovate-ops@finovate.co
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on slots + preflight pack

Diego,

Thanks — appreciate the checklist and agenda. The 24th/10:00 PST won't work for our engineering lead (timezone conflict). We can do 25th after 12:30, or 27th in the morning. Our ops team (copied) prefers a 90-min window with the final 30 minutes reserved for a quick load smoke test.

Two asks before we lock:
1) Can you share a short attendee list template so we can confirm roles?
2) We'll need a brief routing diagram (high level) to share with security before the session.

Regards,
Aria

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Aria Lopez <aria.lopez@finovate.co>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — proposed hands-on slots + preflight pack

Hi Aria — great, thanks for the windows.

We can do:
- Wed 2026-02-25 13:00-14:30 PST (preferred)
- Fri 2026-02-27 08:30-10:00 PST (backup)

Attached is a one-page attendee template (included below) and a high-level routing diagram link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz (see "network-routing.png"). The diagram covers VPC peering, optional proxy, and where KV cache warmup will be triggered.

Attendee template (paste into reply):
- Name / Title / Email / Role for session (primary contact, proxy, security observer)

Notes on load test: we suggest 20 concurrent lightweight prompt threads for 10 minutes to validate autoscaling and request routing. Ben will own the runbook; Priyom will instrument metrics and KV warmup.

SOW / quick terms: if you need the SOW executed before hands-on we can route the DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&id=abc123 otherwise we can proceed on demo terms and finalize later.

If 25th works, we'll send a calendar invite with a shared drive folder containing the pre-reads.

Thanks,
Diego

Attachments referenced: attendee-template.txt (inline), network-routing.png (in Drive)

Subject: Re: POC hands-on session — runbook notes / routing check

Diego / Priyom —

I'll set a tentative calendar invite for 25 Feb 13:00 PST pending Aria confirmation. Quick checklist here for the run:
- Verify KV cache pre-warm script runs 10 mins before session start (script: kv_warmup_v2.sh)
- Confirm proxy route for customer-origin IP range (ops to confirm list)
- Prepare a short prompt deck (5 slides) that maps to Prompt-Seed-Set.csv
- Load smoke test: 20 concurrent threads x 10 min, throttle at token rate 1.2x normal until autoscale triggers

Priyom - can you stub a Grafana dashboard link and share with Finovate ops? If you want, I can attach the invite with a 15-min prep call for red-team/security review.

Ben

Attachments: runbook-snippet.md (5KB)

- Aria Lopez / Head of Product / aria.lopez@finovate.co / primary contact
- Ravi Shah / Platform Engineer / ravi.shah@finovate.co / ops lead
- Mina Alvarez / Security Manager / mina.alvarez@finovate.co / security observer

Attached is a single zip with our attendee IDs for access. Looking forward to the session — please send calendar invite + prep folder link when ready.

Best,
Aria
